spans.text: - (6) The SPC’s procedures must include—
- (4) The public procurement subgroup’s procedures must include—

folded.id: sustainable development|under|the wfga 2015 (see part 2)
folded.subject: sustainable development
folded.object: the WFGA 2015 (see Part 2)

spans.text: - (b) the pursuit of the “A prosperous Wales” well-being goal by public bodies when carrying out sustainable development under the WFGA 2015 (see Part 2);

folded.id: the meeting|must|be chaired by a welsh minister or deputy welsh minister nominated by the first minister
folded.subject: the meeting
folded.object: be chaired by a Welsh Minister or Deputy Welsh Minister nominated by the First Minister

spans.text: - (3) Where it is not possible for the First Minister to chair a meeting, the meeting must be chaired by a Welsh Minister or Deputy Welsh Minister nominated by the First Minister.

folded.id: the procedure|for|resolving a disagreement between members relating to the exercise of the spc’s functions
folded.subject: the procedure
folded.object: resolving a disagreement between members relating to the exercise of the SPC’s functions

spans.text: - (b) the procedure for resolving a disagreement between members relating to the exercise of the SPC’s functions;
- (b) the procedure for resolving a disagreement between members relating to the exercise of the subgroup’s functions;

folded.id: the procedures|for|arranging meetings including notice to be given to attendees and how attendees may add items to the agenda for meetings
folded.subject: the procedures
folded.object: arranging meetings including notice to be given to attendees and how attendees may add items to the agenda for meetings

spans.text: - (a) the procedures for arranging meetings including notice to be given to attendees and how attendees may add items to the agenda for meetings;
- (c) the procedures for providing information and advice to the Welsh Ministers.
- (a) the procedures for arranging meetings including notice to be given to attendees and how attendees may add items to the agenda for meetings;
- (c) the procedures for providing information and advice to the SPC and the Welsh Ministers.

folded.id: the procedures|to|be followed by the public procurement subgroup
folded.subject: the procedures
folded.object: be followed by the public procurement subgroup

spans.text: - (b) the procedures to be followed by the public procurement subgroup, in so far as they are not specified in this Act.

folded.id: the procedures|to|be followed by the spc
folded.subject: the procedures
folded.object: be followed by the SPC

spans.text: - (b) the procedures to be followed by the SPC, in so far as they are not specified in this Act.

folded.id: the quorum|for|public procurement subgroup meetings
folded.subject: the quorum
folded.object: public procurement subgroup meetings

spans.text: - (a) the quorum for public procurement subgroup meetings, and

folded.id: the quorum|for|spc meetings
folded.subject: the quorum
folded.object: SPC meetings

spans.text: - (a) the quorum for SPC meetings, and

folded.id: the spc|carry|out its functions in any ways specified by the spc
folded.subject: the SPC
folded.object: out its functions in any ways specified by the SPC

spans.text: - (b) help the SPC carry out its functions in any ways specified by the SPC.

folded.id: the spc|is|to consist of the following members—
folded.subject: The SPC
folded.object: to consist of the following members—

spans.text: - (1) The SPC is to consist of the following members—

- (5) In this Act, a reference to the “*Social Partnership Council for Wales*” or “*SPC*” is a reference to the members of the SPC acting jointly; accordingly, a function expressed as a function of the SPC is a function of each member that may only be exercised jointly with the other members.

folded.id: the spc|may|establish subgroups
folded.subject: The SPC
folded.object: establish subgroups

spans.text: - (1) The SPC may establish subgroups.

folded.id: the spc|may|provide information and advice to the welsh ministers in relation to—
folded.subject: the SPC
folded.object: provide information and advice to the Welsh Ministers in relation to—

spans.text: - (2) For the purposes of improving economic, environmental, social, and cultural well-being (including by improving public services) in Wales, the SPC may provide information and advice to the Welsh Ministers in relation to—
- (3) The SPC may provide information or advice on a matter referred to in subsection (2) of its own accord or in response to a request made by the Welsh Ministers.

folded.id: the spc|must|have regard to that guidance
folded.subject: the SPC
folded.object: have regard to that guidance

spans.text: - (5) The Welsh Ministers must issue guidance about the composition of the public procurement subgroup (including for the purpose of achieving an appropriately representative membership), and the SPC must have regard to that guidance.

folded.id: the spc|must|meet at least 3 times in each 12 month period beginning with the day after the first minister has made all the initial appointments mentioned in section 2
folded.subject: The SPC
folded.object: meet at least 3 times in each 12 month period beginning with the day after the First Minister has made all the initial appointments mentioned in section 2

spans.text: - (1) The SPC must meet at least 3 times in each 12 month period beginning with the day after the First Minister has made all the initial appointments mentioned in section 2.

folded.id: the spc|must|provide the information or advice as soon as reasonably practicable
folded.subject: the SPC
folded.object: provide the information or advice as soon as reasonably practicable

spans.text: - (4) Where the SPC receives a request from the Welsh Ministers under subsection (3), the SPC must provide the information or advice as soon as reasonably practicable.

folded.id: the spc|must|take all reasonable steps to establish a public procurement subgroup within 6 months beginning with the day after this subsection comes into force
folded.subject: The SPC
folded.object: take all reasonable steps to establish a public procurement subgroup within 6 months beginning with the day after this subsection comes into force

spans.text: - (1) The SPC must take all reasonable steps to establish a public procurement subgroup within 6 months beginning with the day after this subsection comes into force.

folded.id: the spc|receives|a request from the welsh ministers under subsection (3)
folded.subject: the SPC
folded.object: a request from the Welsh Ministers under subsection (3)

spans.text: - (4) Where the SPC receives a request from the Welsh Ministers under subsection (3), the SPC must provide the information or advice as soon as reasonably practicable.

folded.id: there is|to|be a social partnership council for wales (“*spc*”)
folded.subject: There is
folded.object: be a Social Partnership Council for Wales (“*SPC*”)

spans.text: - (1) There is to be a Social Partnership Council for Wales (“*SPC*”).

folded.id: this act|imposes|on public bodies and the welsh ministers (see part 2)
folded.subject: this Act
folded.object: on public bodies and the Welsh Ministers (see Part 2)

spans.text: - (a) the social partnership duties which this Act imposes on public bodies and the Welsh Ministers (see Part 2);

folded.id: welsh government|members|are to include the first minister and
folded.subject: Welsh Government
folded.object: are to include the First Minister and

spans.text: - (2) The Welsh Government members are to include the First Minister and, where invited by the First Minister from time to time—

folded.id: welsh ministers|may|revise anything specified under subsection (2) and must publish any such revisions
folded.subject: Welsh Ministers
folded.object: revise anything specified under subsection (2) and must publish any such revisions

spans.text: - (3) The Welsh Ministers may revise anything specified under subsection (2) and must publish any such revisions.

folded.id: welsh ministers|must|issue guidance about the composition of the public procurement subgroup (including for the purpose of achieving an appropriately representative membership)
folded.subject: Welsh Ministers
folded.object: issue guidance about the composition of the public procurement subgroup (including for the purpose of achieving an appropriately representative membership)

spans.text: - (5) The Welsh Ministers must issue guidance about the composition of the public procurement subgroup (including for the purpose of achieving an appropriately representative membership), and the SPC must have regard to that guidance.

folded.id: welsh ministers|must|make administrative support available to the spc
folded.subject: Welsh Ministers
folded.object: make administrative support available to the SPC

spans.text: - (7) The Welsh Ministers must make administrative support available to the SPC.

folded.id: welsh ministers|must|specify and publish—
folded.subject: Welsh Ministers
folded.object: specify and publish—

spans.text: - (4) Within 6 months beginning with the day after this subsection comes into force, the Welsh Ministers must specify and publish—
- (2) Within 6 months beginning with the day after this subsection comes into force, the Welsh Ministers must specify and publish—

folded.subject: Where it
folded.object: not possible for the First Minister to chair a meeting

spans.text: - (3) Where it is not possible for the First Minister to chair a meeting, the meeting must be chaired by a Welsh Minister or Deputy Welsh Minister nominated by the First Minister.
